facts.text: Erskine College was founded in Due West, South Carolina, by the Associate Reformed Presbyterian (ARP) Church in 1839.

sources.title: History & Traditions - Erskine College
sources.quote: Erskine College was founded by the Associate Reformed Presbyterian (ARP) Church in 1839. Prior to this time the church had established an academy for men in Due West, S.C., in 1835
